entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 5300300156538723328: position at J2016.0. Distance: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 45556: distance 234.742 pc, the paper's parallax inverted (Gaia DR1's where it revised the star's, else the Hipparcos reduction of van Leeuwen 2007; section 2.3; fractional uncertainty 0.023), at which the luminosity and radius hold (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433): 234.742 +/- 5.399 pc; Gaia DR3 gives this source no parallax (a two-parameter solution). Proper motion: Gaia DR3 source 5300300156538723328 is a two-parameter solution with no proper motion; zero is assumed (at 235 pc, 1 mas/yr would be 1 km/s across the sky). Radial velocity from SIMBAD's radial velocity for Gaia DR3 5300300156538723328 (quality A), from 2006AstL...32..759G; Gaia DR3 measures none.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 46.95 solar radii from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 45556: radius 46.95 solar radii, implied by the fitted luminosity 5026.94 solar luminosities (fractional uncertainty 0.052) and temperature (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433). No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 7098 +/- 183 K from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 45556: effective temperature 7098 +/- 183 K, from the fit of a model atmosphere to the star's spectral energy distribution (goodness of fit Q 0.043).

entries.subject: Color
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at 7,098 K, because no archive holds a spectrum of this star (stis-ngsl: HD 80404 is not in the library; pulkovo: HR 3699 is not in the catalogue; kiehling: HR 3699 is not among its 60 stars; kharitonov: HR 3699 is not in the catalogue; burnashev: BS 3699 is not in part2; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it), through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #f2f1ff. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: HD 80404 is not in the library; pulkovo: HR 3699 is not in the catalogue; kiehling: HR 3699 is not among its 60 stars; kharitonov: HR 3699 is not in the catalogue; burnashev: BS 3699 is not in part2; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; planck: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 7,098 K and log g 1.6 (u1 0.484, u2 0.214): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used. Gravity: log g 1.6 from 1992ApJS...79..303L, the median of its 2 spectra; the 7 published values span log g 1.4 to 1.6, across which the limb law changes by at most 0.1% of the centre brightness.
